headline: Federal court blocks Alabama's congressional map, orders new lines drawn
snippet: Three-judge panel struck down map for failing to create second majority-Black district.

headline: Alabama appeals to the Supreme Court after map dilutes Black voters' power again
snippet: Legislature drew map that state admitted didn't create required second majority-Black district.

headline: Alabama: Federal court strikes down congressional map after legislature snubbed Supreme Court
snippet: Judges wrote they were 'deeply troubled' that Alabama enacted map it 'readily admits does not provide the remedy.'
